cohort: 5454 AD patients and 16,362 control subjects without AD from Taiwan's National Health Insurance Research Database (1997-2013)
finding: Early-life infections, particularly infectious diseases and skin infections, are associated with an increased risk of atopic dermatitis development in infancy and early childhood.
mod_finding: The study found no association between Caesarean delivery and the development of atopic dermatitis in infancy and early childhood.
